selectionRationale: Existing native bounded upload already prevents full-file bytesSync, but creator preview plus hidden feed decoders and prewarmed interstitial overlap can exacerbate the previously proven Android heap pressure. Minimal screen-focus lifecycle fix avoids changing native storage/API and monetization. Current production R10 IGPAT RPC checks storage.objects only in community-media; prior >45MiB AWS upload causes deterministic 'Uploaded IGPAT video was not found' after transport success. Supabase Pro community-media bucket is configured for 1GiB and existing 6MiB TUS client handles weak-network uploads. Remove AWS write branch and fail closed on unknown video size.
